# bpsea -- one row per country per battle (SEA).
#
# Replaces balance_bpsea_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 4,001 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="bpsea_b"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (7), each a map of its own:
#     b        <- var:pend_b
#     c        <- this
#     s        <- var:pend_s
#     n0       <- var:cbd6
#     n1       <- var:cbd7
#     n2       <- var:cbd8
#     n3       <- var:cbd9
#
# global_var:bpsea_count is still the row count and still the last key written.

bpsea_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bpsea_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bpsea_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bpsea_count add = 1 }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpsea_b key = global_var:bpsea_count value = var:pend_b }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpsea_c key = global_var:bpsea_count value = this }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpsea_s key = global_var:bpsea_count value = var:pend_s }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpsea_n0 key = global_var:bpsea_count value = var:cbd6 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpsea_n1 key = global_var:bpsea_count value = var:cbd7 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpsea_n2 key = global_var:bpsea_count value = var:cbd8 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpsea_n3 key = global_var:bpsea_count value = var:cbd9 }
}
